title: GROUNDING-AGENT-002: Grounding v0.2 active-lane & handoff provenance guard
intent: Additively extend the existing Grounding Agent v0.1 with handoff/session-lane provenance checking, without rebuilding the active-lane machinery v0.1 already has. Adds a handoff_provenance claim type (program/work-order/repository match against the active lane), an optional top-level evidence_lanes list (foreign EVIDENCE_ONLY read-only evidence), a controlled HANDOFF_LANE_CONFLICT reason on ClaimResult, and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when required provenance is absent. Deterministic only — no NLP, no keyword classifier, no orchestration, no second agent, no production behavior change. Existing ActiveLane model, active_lane claim, CrossRepoPolicy, GA-HIST-05 behavior, and all v0.1 serialization/CLI remain unchanged. Records GA-TRIAL-0007 (the real MATCH/PROCEED grounding of this handoff).

diff_articulation.what_changed: models.py: add handoff_provenance ClaimType, EvidenceMode, EvidenceLane, ClaimReason, optional request.evidence_lanes (omitted when empty), optional ClaimResult.reason (omitted when None). evidence.py: pure lane helpers (normalize_repo_identifier, compare_repository_identity, lane_label_matches, evidence_lane_is_permitted). engine.py: _check_handoff_provenance handler + dispatch entry + _result reason passthrough; active_lane handler unchanged. Tests: model/engine cases (GA2-001..012), six synthetic GA-LANE fixtures + loader reason assertion, GA2-011 no-NLP guard. Docs: GROUNDING_AGENT_v0.2.md + v0.2 example. Ledger: GA-TRIAL-0007 row + incident note + aggregate update.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: v0.1 detects cross-repo mutation but has no way to detect that a same-repository handoff belongs to the wrong program/work-order, and no explicit foreign-evidence declaration. This adds exactly that missing provenance dimension as a new claim type, deterministically, while reusing (not duplicating) the existing active-lane contract.
